data.name: Heart of Eternity
data.detailed_description:
Youth is no obstacle when the whole world awaits your help! An old sword, a little magic, and you can set out in search of adventure. But it turns out that making a decision is often more difficult than accomplishing a heroic feat. The powerful baron and the Holy Inquisition, magical races and hordes of undead — all are eager to find ancient artifacts and gain power over the world. So who will you help, and who will lose their head? Bloody battles and destructive sorcery, ambition and intrigue will lead you to unravel the mystery of the world of Sarcus!

  • Epic non-linear storyline. Shape the fate of Sarcus through branching paths, multiple endings, and over 150 immersive quests.

  • Seamless open world. Explore a vast, continuous world without loading zones. Ride across the land and discover hidden places at your own pace.

  • Deep RPG progression. Customize your hero with five core attributes, dozens of secondary stats, and diverse combat specializations.

  • Master combat or magic. Choose your style: wield mighty swords, dual blades, bows, or unlock the secrets of four powerful schools of magic.

  • Skill-based combat. No auto-lock targeting — every strike is manual, rewarding precision and skill. Unleash devastating blows to cut down multiple foes at once.

  • Realistic armor mechanics. Protect yourself piece by piece — helmets, gauntlets, boots, and more. Forget one, and you leave yourself dangerously exposed.

  • Rich lore & living world. Dive into the history, rivalries, and cultures of elves, orcs, goblins, gnomes, humans, vampires, and more in a fully realized fantasy universe.

We would like to thank the active members of the gaming community for their hard work in translating the game into English!

Translation by:

  • VicemanUral

  • Pietro F. aka Litmanen

Special thanks to:

  • Hag – for creating the excellent extraction/reinsertion tool that made this translation possible and manageable.

  • Kira Lacroix – for his work on the maps and graphical interface.

Without the combined efforts of these people, this project would not have been feasible. Thank you!
